BiblicalUsage: behalah covers sudden terror and ruin, and it appears 4 times across the Bible. Moses warns that sudden terror will fall on a disobedient people, and Jeremiah says a mother's children will be taken from her in a moment of horror.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sudden terror is the Bible's honest picture of judgment — it does not creep up slowly, it falls. That is why I keep coming back to it: behalah is not a word to rush past.
